source_text.body:
Let an agent run a business autonomously from zero
Author set up Claude Code with memory and a decision log to pick moves each session; over 31 sessions across five markets it earned $0.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
Claude Code got a memory directory, a decision log and a world-model file. Each session it read its state, chose the highest-value move, did it and recorded what it learned. The author set the goal of making money from $0 and made the pivot calls when asked. The agent tried an affiliate site, bounties, free tools with a tip jar, and freelance gigs.
How it went
After 31 sessions revenue was $0.00. The assets were a plugin marketplace with six skills, one PR pending merge and a bug report. The Reddit post got 320 views. The agent concluded that every attempt lacked an audience, a marketplace or a body.
Worth knowing
The agent sold code and text generation, which the market already prices near zero. Check that your product isn't the thing that just became free before copying this.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Act as an autonomous operator trying to make my first $[target] in [market or niche]. Keep a memory file and a decision log, and at the start of each session review them and choose one next move with your reasoning. Pause and show me before spending money, creating accounts, or publishing anything, and end each session by logging results and a recommended next step.
Original source: https://dev.to/duckduckduck/i-gave-an-ai-agent-a-business-and-0-it-found-the-one-thing-ai-cant-sell-38ne
